title: Pompeo: 'I saw the UFO files, too'
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Pompeo: 'I saw the UFO files, too', about an unknown time at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But I will say this is a very weird non-sequitur from former CIA Director Mike Pompeo, when asked why the nearly 5000 JFK files still won't be released to this day.

Pompeo when he was interviewed by judge NPO aano very awkward kind of segue from you know was like are you going to release the JFK files he goes no you know we can't do that some of the people are still alive and then he goes uh you know I've seen the the UAP files as well

tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Pompeo's odd segue from the withheld JFK files to saying he had also seen the UFO/UAP files.

as_told.title: Pompeo links the withheld JFK files to the UAP files in his Napolitano interview

plain: This story is about a strange remark by Mike Pompeo, a former head of the CIA, the main US spy agency. The podcast host Jesse Michels says that when Pompeo was asked why thousands of government files about the killing of President John F. Kennedy still had not been released, he changed the subject in an odd way. According to the telling, Pompeo said he had also seen the UFO files. A journalist, Michael Shellenberger, tells the same story on the same podcast. He says the interviewer was a TV host known as Judge Napolitano, and that Pompeo first said the Kennedy files could not be released because some of the people involved are still alive. Then, Shellenberger says, Pompeo added that he had seen the UAP files as well, UAP being the government's newer word for UFOs. It is told because, if taken at face value, it suggests a former spy chief has seen secret UFO records.
